$comment: Per-repo harness config. Every launch flag overrides the matching field. Keys starting with $ are documentation.
$url: Where the app answers once it is up. doctor checks it; launch opens it.
$app: Set to start the app yourself, e.g. {"command": "npm run dev", "cwd": "../../..", "readyTimeoutMs": 90000}. cwd is relative to this directory (../../.. is the repo root, the default). Leave null (or pass --no-app) to drive an instance that is already running. launch refuses to start the app if url already answers.
$cdp: Attach to a running Chromium or Electron app instead of launching one, e.g. "http://127.0.0.1:9222". The app must have been started with --remote-debugging-port=9222.
$marker: CSS selector that only the app under test renders, e.g. "[data-app='myapp']" or "#app-root". doctor requires it; in attach mode it picks the right page among several.
$channel: null uses the Chromium that Playwright installs; "chrome" or "msedge" uses the browser already on the machine (no download).
$timeoutMs: Default per-action timeout. Override per command with --timeout.
$env: Extra environment for the app process and browser, e.g. {"APP_DATA_DIR": "/tmp/verify-data"} so runs never touch real user data.
